reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing shouldSetMonthBudget/getMonthActionCategories pair, but parses the tag with an inline regex instead of shared/tags extractTagsFromText, and does not reach copyPreviousMonth's existing filter.

duplication.why: Adds no copied block, only an inline regex that re-expresses the shared tag parser.

placement.why: The predicate change lives in the shared month-action predicate in budget/actions.ts, the right spot.

scope.why: A two-line rule change, one join and one test.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but the month-wide exclusion is still split between shouldSetMonthBudget and copyPreviousMonth's inline checks, so the new rule silently misses copy-previous-month.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Inline /#fixed/ regex in shouldSetMonthBudget bypasses extractTagsFromText; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own exclusion over getBudgetData instead of shouldSetMonthBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic copied; the tag regex is a reimplementation rather than a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: Rule added only to shouldSetMonthBudget; copyPreviousMonth applies its own hidden/template/income checks and gets no #fixed exclusion.
